name: Do I need permits for accessible home modifications?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for accessible home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many accessible home modifications, especially those involving structural changes, electrical work, plumbing, or significant alterations to a home's footprint, typically require building permits. Minor cosmetic changes or the installation of non-structural items like grab bars usually do not. We can advise you on the specific permit requirements for your project in the Bay Area and surrounding cities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are often required for structural, electrical, or plumbing changes. Minor installations typically do not. We advise on permit needs for your project.
